title: The Need for a Socially-Grounded Persona Framework for User Simulation
findings: Religion, as a standalone demographic factor, was found to have a very low correlation (r = +0.028) with human response similarity. This supports the paper's main conclusion that personas based solely on demographics (including religion) are weak predictors of behavior and can lead to over-accentuation of group characteristics.

measurement_description: Religion was measured as a demographic attribute to assess how demographic similarity (including religious affiliation) correlates with similarity in human survey responses. It was not used to measure bias against specific religious groups but rather as one of several demographic variables.
